'''Corlioon''' was located on the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Bastion/Legends|Bastion]].<ref name="Vision of the Future">''[[Vision of the Future]]''</ref>

Sometime in [[19 ABY/Legends|19 ABY]], [[Han Solo/Legends|Han Solo]] and [[Lando Calrissian/Legends|Lando Calrissian]] were spotted by [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Imperials]] on the corner of [[Regisine]] and Corlioon while looking for a copy of the [[Caamas Document]].<ref name="Vision of the Future" />
